title: Value at a listed coordinate
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\eta$ assign a restriction state to each of the $n$ coordinates, let $L$ be a list of coordinates with no repetitions, and let $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$. For any coordinate $i$ in $L$, the assignment obtained by fixing the coordinates in $L$ according to the signs encoded by $x$ has at $i$ the fixed state determined by the sign encoded by $x_i$.
hypotheses_covered: A list $L$ of coordinates with no repetitions
